description: BLOCKER: https://hexdocs.pm/hammer/7.5.0/distributed-ets.html documents an application-owned Phoenix.PubSub listener receiving only {:inc,key,scale,increment} and invoking Local.inc. Hammer.ETS itself is local; no separate hammer_backend_ets dependency. v7.5.0 lib/hammer/ets/fix_window.ex and fix_window_per_key.ex expose local set/get/expires_at, without synchronized cooldown/reset. Guide explicitly leaves new-node empty counters and net-split recovery uncovered. Need user decision whether to authorize ZAQ-owned replication extension for independent non-extending cooldown and fresh post-cooldown budget, including delayed increments/reset ordering, or adjust cooldown semantics to documented increment-only behavior. No claim that basic distributed ETS/PubSub is unsupported. Before implementation, validate concrete scenarios: cooldown shorter/longer than failure window, cross-node threshold, reset with delayed hits, configuration changes, restart/partition semantics. No production edits while blocked; sources checked read-only; no mocks or automated tests needed for this research. Record decision and pinned dependency in this issue.

comments.text: RESOLVED by user: V1 uses native Hammer retry_after and normal fixed-window expiry; no independent cooldown deadlines/reset replication. Remove unknown_email_cooldown_seconds from active typed config/UI/tests/docs, retain legacy stored key unused. Official increment-only ETS/PubSub pattern approved; document new-node/split limitations.
